title: Hardcoded Service Host IP Endpoints
pattern: Hardcoding static IP addresses or port numbers in application constants instead of using logical names or configuration.
why_bad: Violates the dynamic nature of operational environments. If a server is rescheduled onto another host, the application fails to resolve it, requiring recompilation or redeployment.
detection: Hardcoded IP address patterns inside source code constants or string literals used for socket connections.
counterexample: Binding to localhost (`127.0.0.1` or `[::1]`) for internal local testing or testing loopback sockets.
fix: Use a DNS name or external configuration with a service discovery mechanism.
